evidence.observedFact: The official site positions Westel's as a neighborhood social venue, promotes its hidden speakeasy/party room for private events, and publishes a dedicated event-reservation email.
The official contact page states private parties are welcome and provides direct business contact details; no visible loyalty or rewards mechanic was found on the reviewed contact/about pages.

gaps.recommendedFix: Validate the current private-event follow-up process, then demonstrate a permissioned post-event return-visit and referral loop tied to speakeasy and party bookings.
Validate any existing private loyalty process and demonstrate a lightweight repeat-visit reward that complements the venue's neighborhood positioning.

notes: Private-event activity and public business contact are directly observed. Absence of a visible rewards mechanic on reviewed public pages is only a hypothesis. Confirm current CRM, POS, email, loyalty, and event follow-up before claiming a gap or revenue impact.
